name: Web Research
description: Lets the AI search the web and read pages, with every fetched page treated as untrusted content.

webResearch.braveApiKey.label: Brave Search API Key
webResearch.braveApiKey.description: Brave Search API key, needed for web searches. Get one at brave.com/search/api. Kept encrypted on this computer.

webResearch.dailyBudget.label: Searches Per Day
webResearch.dailyBudget.description: Most web searches allowed per day. Resets at local midnight.

webResearch.perTurnSearchCap.label: Searches Per Reply
webResearch.perTurnSearchCap.description: Most web searches the AI may make in one reply.

webResearch.perTurnFetchCap.label: Pages Read Per Reply
webResearch.perTurnFetchCap.description: Most pages the AI may read in one reply.
